summary_en: The company increased its interim dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 2027 by adding a 5 yen commemorative dividend to mark its fifth anniversary on September 1, 2024. The per-share interim dividend is now projected at 20 yen, comprising 15 yen in regular dividend and 5 yen in commemorative dividend, resulting in a full-year dividend forecast of 40 yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Interim Dividend Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 (Fifth Anniversary Commemorative Dividend)
translation_en_brief: Juroku Financial Group announced a revision to its interim dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 2027. The company increased the per-share interim dividend from a previously forecast 15 yen to 20 yen, comprising 15 yen in regular dividend and 5 yen in commemorative dividend. This increase was decided at a Board of Directors meeting held on September 9, 2024, with the record date set for September 30, 2024. The commemorative dividend reflects the company's milestone of reaching its fifth anniversary on September 1, 2024. With the interim dividend increase, the full-year dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 2027 rose to 40 yen, an increase of 5 yen from the previous full-year forecast. The final dividend is expected to remain at 20 yen as previously announced. The formal determination of the interim dividend amount is scheduled to be made at the Board of Directors meeting in December 2024.
